security_privacy_cost_impact: None. No secret, credential, customer data, provider call, or network access is introduced. The change is Node-only repository tooling and documentation. Its security effect is positive: six contract tests that guard tenant-isolation and unsafe-payload negative cases now execute in CI instead of silently not running.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No schema, migration, migration reservation, or persisted data is created or altered.
compatibility_impact: npm run check now executes 32 tests instead of 26. Any future test-kits subdirectory is picked up automatically. No public contract, API, event, or job envelope changes. package-lock.json is unmodified, so the installed dependency graph is unchanged.
known_limitations: RFC-2026-003 is Proposed, not approved; it requires independent review, security review, test, integration evidence, and Product Owner disposition.

The cross-package manifest amendments are authorized by RFC-2026-003 and declared in this manifest, but the ownership validator cannot express cross-package amendment authority; this remains a documented procedural control, not a technical one.
This package does not re-execute or re-certify WP-0A-CON-001 evidence against the corrected command; the Integration Owner must decide whether that re-execution is required.
Role assignments beyond Author are null; the package stays at backlog until each independent run records its own capability declaration.
open_risks_or_blockers: Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending. This package does not advance it.
Native branch protection remains unavailable; RFC-2026-002 manual merge control still applies and the Product Owner performs the merge.

WP-0A-CON-001's recorded review, test, and integration evidence cited a command that excluded its own contract tests. Whether that invalidates the evidence is an Integration Owner decision, not an Author decision.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert this branch through a reviewed revert PR. Reverting restores the previous test:bootstrap glob and the previous WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 ownership declarations exactly. No persisted data, provider state, credential, migration, or customer-data effect exists, so no recovery procedure is required.
